kin.name: Человек
kin.summary: Самая многочисленная и культурно разнообразная раса Островов. Гвирлы встречаются повсеместно; конкисты редки и связаны с древней человеческой знатью.

kin.name: Полуэльф
kin.summary: Потомки людей и эльфов. Часто живут между двумя культурами и отличаются восприимчивостью к знаниям и чудотворству.

kin.name: Эльф
kin.summary: Долгоживущая раса багрового камня. Сенхедиры известны изяществом, аркандары — взрывной физической мощью.

kin.name: Дварф
kin.summary: Крепкие долгожители, тесно связанные с Тиробором и ремесленными традициями. Подрасы различаются происхождением и редкостью.

kin.name: Орк
kin.summary: Редкая на большинстве населённых островов раса с множеством племенных культур. Орки взрослеют быстро и редко доживают до старости.

kin.name: Гоблин
kin.summary: Небольшие, быстрые и живучие представители племенных и городских общин. Часто говорят на диалектах иктар-карума.

kin.name: Волколак
kin.summary: Волколаки, или люди-волки. Редки, быстро взрослеют и заметно отличаются от людей физиологией и обычаями.

kin.name: Полурослик
kin.summary: Полурослики редки и обычно живут небольшими общинами среди других народов. Их долголетие близко к человеческому.

professions.name: Champion
professions.summary: Стойкость, клятвы, защита и личная доблесть. Профессия определяет механику, а не общественное положение персонажа.

professions.name: Druid
professions.summary: Чудотворство через природу, исцеление, образы, лёд, рои и иные школы. Для первого персонажа требует внимательного выбора заклинаний.

professions.name: Fighter
professions.summary: Физическая подготовка и специализированные боевые Path. Path of the Bullet дополнительно даёт профессиональный фокус AGI.

professions.name: Hunter
professions.summary: Стрельба, выслеживание, скрытность, звери и выживание.

professions.name: Monster Hunter
professions.summary: Профессиональный охотник на чудовищ, который изучает добычу, готовит специализированное снаряжение и использует знания о слабостях монстров.

professions.name: Minstrel
professions.summary: Влияние через голос, музыку, гимны и боевые кличи.

professions.name: Peddler
professions.summary: Торговля, ремесло, сокровища, связи и искусство убеждения.

professions.name: Rider
professions.summary: Верховая езда, командование, рыцарские приёмы и связь со спутником.

professions.name: Rogue
professions.summary: Скрытность, проникновение, убийство, яды и социальная маска.

professions.name: Sorcerer
professions.summary: Чудотворство через кровь, смерть, элементы, знаки, камень и смешанные школы.

origins.name: Сиростьен
origins.summary: Крупнейшая парламентская республика и главный наследник Дамийской Империи. Сиростьен объединяет множество народов, располагает сильнейшей огнестрельной армией Островов и пытается совместить республиканскую свободу с тяжёлым имперским наследием.

origins.name: Изуавер
origins.summary: Древний гигантский город-государство из жёлтого и белого камня, бывшая столица Дамии и крупнейший торгово-культурный центр Островов. Им управляют восемь манусов, а чудотворцы могут официально служить при власти.

origins.name: Сангрен
origins.summary: Первый Воздушный Остров и одно из самых традиционных человеческих королевств. Сангрен хранит наследие Великих Налетчиков, особенно чтит Стальную Веру и превращает соревнование, турниры и стремление быть первым в основу общественной жизни.

origins.name: Флёченранд
origins.summary: Индустриальная технократия фабрик, шахт, университетов и патентов. Флёченранд создаёт самые передовые механизмы мира, но платит за прогресс загрязнением, перенаселёнными городами, зависимостью от импорта пищи и тяжёлой жизнью пролей.

origins.name: Нованд
origins.summary: Свободолюбивое королевство, раздираемое гражданской войной и борьбой претендентов на трон. Нованд технологически отстаёт от соседей, но славится вином, наёмниками, поэзией, плодородными землями и непримиримым стремлением к независимости.

origins.name: Лежнизем
origins.summary: Молодая конфедерация сотен независимых феодалов, кланов и земель, возникшая после распада Велькизема. Лежнизем держится на договорах, родовой чести, военной силе и постоянном смешении культур соседних народов.

origins.name: Тиробор
origins.summary: Горное клановое государство, где дварфийские цехи, шахты и родовые традиции определяют общество. Тиробор богат рудами и ремеслом, ценит честный труд, надёжность и старые обычаи, но остаётся закрытым и неприветливым к чужакам.

origins.name: Якнизем
origins.summary: Выборное ханство, где власть ежегодно переходит к новому хану, а воинская честь соседствует с торговой предприимчивостью. Якнизем выглядит хаотичным для чужака, но живёт по устойчивой системе родов, договоров, гуляй-городов и вооружённой вольницы.

origins.name: Хорслия
origins.summary: Горное княжество-близнец Онтаквы, часть богатой «Алмазной Короны» восточного Гристона. Хорслия опирается на шахты, самоцветы, укреплённые порты и клановую знать; здесь сильны Тримунэлия, юниатство и традиции кровной чести.

origins.name: Онтаква
origins.summary: Плодородное княжество-близнец Хорслии, связанное с ней общей династией Эггенрахов и Транскарпатским тоннелем. Онтаква богатеет на сельском хозяйстве, кофе и торговле, сочетая клановые обычаи, роскошные города и сильную Тримунэлию.

origins.name: Кальдвельг
origins.summary: Ледяное милитаризованное воеводство рейдеров, пиратов и корабельных мастеров. Кальдвельг живёт морской добычей, суровой дисциплиной и братской памятью о Наэрдэре, а его Небесные Верфи обслуживают одну из самых опасных армад Островов.

origins.name: Наэрдэр
origins.summary: Закрытое жаркое княжество, опустившееся ближе к Чёрной Пустыне после катастрофы кристалла Поднятия. Наэрдэром правит жёсткая иерархия, а заражённые тёмно-фиолетовыми кристаллами составляют особое высшее сословие; культура страны пропитана изоляцией и фатализмом.

origins.name: Болтраск
origins.summary: Старая империя, исторический соперник Дамии и самостоятельный центр промышленности, моды и военной силы. Болтраск соединяет фабрики, железные дороги и плодородные земли с колониальным наследием и чудотворческими программами создания Наследников.

origins.name: Сарройо
origins.summary: Молодая республика Сейку, богатая дешёвой бумагоподобной тканью, книгами и искусством. За культурным блеском Сарройо скрываются слабая государственная армия, олигархия и могущественные преступные семьи, контролирующие торговлю и города.

origins.name: Ройу Сагеки
origins.summary: Военная деспотия и государство-крепость, ведущая непрерывную войну с Ройу Мидеки. Сагеки требует абсолютной дисциплины, чтит совершенство оружия и смерти, развивает инженерию и подавляет любое инакомыслие.

origins.name: Ройу Мидеки
origins.summary: Каррия свободных семей и общин, возникшая в восстании против деспотии Сагеки. Мидеки децентрализован, шумен и непредсказуем, но держится на личном слове, репутации, добровольных союзах и изобретательности оружейников.

origins.name: Дихтбейр
origins.summary: Строгая теократия и сердце Веры Багровой Щуки. Законы Дихтбейра буквально следуют заветам Домитрана, другие религии запрещены, а паломники со всех Островов стекаются к Мировой Гортани и святыням Янтарной Церкви.

origins.name: Другое место
origins.summary: Другое место происхождения, не представленное отдельной страной в справочнике. Культурные особенности, гражданство и подходящий родной язык требуется объяснить в предыстории.

languages.name: Дамийский (Общий)
languages.description: Общий язык бывшей Дамийской Империи, широко известный в городах и среди знати.

languages.name: Болтрасский
languages.description: Язык Болтраска. Полное знание включает базовое владение высоким диалектом.

languages.name: Земский
languages.description: Неофициальный общий язык земель бывшего Велькизема.

languages.name: Перизальский
languages.description: Главный язык Хорслии и Онтаквы, распространённый среди торговцев и путешественников.

languages.name: Ройу
languages.description: Язык бывших колоний Болтраска на Сейку, возникший из смешения местных языков и болтрасского.

languages.name: Тир
languages.description: Язык гор, лесов и равнин Тиробора, сохраняющий связь дварфов с исторической родиной.

languages.name: Флёч
languages.description: Краткий инженерный язык Флёченранда, необходимый для чтения передовых чертежей.

languages.name: Нова
languages.description: Мелодичный язык Нованда, особенно распространённый в сельской местности.

languages.name: Первичный
languages.description: Древний язык времён Черной Пустыни, сохранившийся прежде всего в Сангрене.

languages.name: Спрёнг
languages.description: Язык Кальдвельга и Наэрдэра, одновременно служащий политическим заявлением.

languages.name: Сейтир
languages.description: Язык конкистов и высшей человеческой аристократии.

languages.name: Иктар-карум
languages.description: Общее название множества орочьих и гоблинских диалектов.

languages.name: Церковный
languages.description: Язык Дихтбейра и церквей Веры Багровой Щуки.

languages.name: Тартар
languages.description: Редкий язык демонов и демонических существ. Его знание не требуется для чудотворства.

builderSettings.introText: Создайте персонажа Воздушных Островов по шагам. Конструктор проверяет ограничения, расходы опыта и совместимость с кампанией.

religions.name: Стальная Вера
religions.summary: Самая распространённая вера Островов, выросшая из памяти о Войнах Чести. Она почитает Ржавого, ожидает рождения Младого и хранит культ Семерых Великих Налетчиков; её главные ценности — освобождение, долг, жертва и окончательная победа над кавтурами.

religions.name: Вера Багровой Щуки
religions.summary: Воинственная вера Домитрана, считающая кавтурские технологии духовной заразой и требующая очищения мира от их наследия. Её центр находится в Дихтбейре, а кровавая символика соединяет священный ужас, аскезу и готовность отсечь всё опасное для общества.

religions.name: Янтарная Церковь
religions.summary: Староверческая и наиболее строгая современная ветвь Веры Багровой Щуки. Янтарники требуют буквального следования заветам Домитрана, отвергают опасные изобретения и определяют религиозную жизнь Дихтбейра.

religions.name: Андриатская Церковь
religions.summary: Реформаторская ветвь Веры Багровой Щуки, возникшая в эпоху Искупления. Она не требует полного отказа от изобретений, а учит понимать и преобразовывать технологии, изгоняя из науки кавтурское влияние.

religions.name: Замуд
religions.summary: Запрещённая во многих странах вера жителей Чёрной Пустыни в Аэля как создателя пустыни и кавтуров. Замуды считают страдание источником силы, удовольствие — слабостью, а место людей видят внизу, в бесконечной борьбе за выживание.

religions.name: Тримунэлия
religions.summary: Древняя вера в три луны — Муну, Триа и Аэля, воплощающие память и порядок, тайну и терпение, действие и разрушение оков. Она подчёркивает общий подвиг всех рас в Восстании, особенно распространена в Хорслии и Онтакве и уступает числом верующих только Стальной Вере.

religions.name: Юниатство
religions.summary: Возникшая в Хорслии и Онтакве ветвь Тримунэлии, призывающая объединить все народы и расы в единую юнию. Полуэльфов юниаты считают доказательством того, что смешение способно унаследовать лучшее от разных народов.

religions.name: Рамбар
religions.summary: Всеобщая дварфийская вера в Фильминда, Великого Мастера и Первого Ремесленника. Рамбар учит священному равновесию честного труда и полноценного отдыха: мастерство требует не только работать хорошо, но и вовремя остановиться, чтобы насладиться плодами работы.

religions.name: Фаэлиранство
religions.summary: Фаталистическая вера эльфов и полуэльфов в Ралхазай — безразличную сущность, чьё пробуждение неизбежно уничтожит мир. Фаэлиранство не обещает спасения и не пытается отсрочить конец, а учит спокойно смотреть на небытие и жить без утешительной лжи.

religions.name: Дети Подшерстка
religions.summary: Малочисленная вера в Этту, великую мать людей-животных. Её последователи защищают естественный ход дикой природы от вмешательства цивилизации; у веры нет единой церкви, пророков или обязательных писаний, и присоединиться к ней может представитель любой расы.

religions.name: Племенные орочьи и гоблинские верования
religions.summary: Множество местных шаманских традиций, в которых духи населяют предметы, места и повседневные занятия. Перед охотой, работой, сном или дорогой верующие обращаются к соответствующему духу; единого канона и общей церковной структуры не существует.

religions.name: Критики
religions.summary: Растущее нерелигиозное движение, отрицающее богов и выступающее против организованных церквей. Критики считают устойчивые религиозные системы источником заблуждений и занимаются прежде всего просветительством, а не созданием собственной веры.

religions.name: Нет определённой веры
religions.summary: Персонаж не исповедует конкретную религию, сомневается в существовании богов или не считает веру значимой частью своей жизни.

system.description:
You carry a knapsack that contains a seemingly endless supply of stuff and knick knacks. The knapsack is a HEAVY item (@JournalEntry[Character Creation]).
The GM should only allow a Peddler to create something when it is about to be used, and when it is not to be used, it instead costs no WP, a drawn tool will then simply be the same piece every time you draw it... and if you later have no WP when you are in real need of it, you have simply lost it.

✥ RANK 1: When you spend WP, you can find almost any item from the list of trade goods (see @JournalEntry[Trade Goods]). It cannot be a HEAVY object and it cannot cost more than 1 piece of silver per WP spent.

✥ RANK 2: As per RANK 1, but you can also find a weapon (from the weapon tables) in your knapsack.

✥ RANK 3: As per RANK 2, but the item can cost up to 1 piece of gold per WP spent.

COMMENT: Once you have pulled an item from your knapsack, you must write it down on your character sheet, and you cannot put it back in your knapsack again. If you lose your knapsack, you must get a new one before you can use this talent again. This requires a visit to a trading post of some kind and that you spend a WP and [[/r 2d6]] silver.

✥ RANK 4: You can now have one or more stashes (likely in wagons or stores). A stash takes up 25 units of weight, so you likely need a wagon or other location to store it. To gain one you also need to visit to a trading post. Your first stash is free, but if you need to regain one, you have to spend a WP and [[/r 2d6]] gold. You may from your stash pull heavy objects, shields, armors, clothes, raw materials and tools, in addition to the options available from your knapsack.
✥ RANK 5: When drawing an item, you may either draw it as a masterwork item, with a +1 bonus, or double the value of your WP, so that each WP counts as if worth 2 gold.

You are a natural @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.A6nMThgWXLeqh4dd]{leader}. To use these powers, your allies have to be able to understand you.

✥ RANK 1: As a Fast Action, you may shout a command for something that can be taken as a Fast Action. Up to an amount of party members equal to the WP spent, may immediately take this action as a Free Action, temporarily breaking the turn order. The party members with lowest initiative acts first.

✥ RANK 2: As a fast reaction, you may make a Performance roll to reduce the effect of a fear attack, on a one-[x]-for-one-[x] ratio. You may affect a number of allies within S equal to the amount of WP spent. If you are also affected by the fear attack, you take any damage to EMP instead of WIT.

✥ RANK 3: As per RANK 1, but the command can be for something that can be taken as a Slow Action.

✥ RANK 4: As per RANK 3, but you may spend an additional WP to add a +2 modifier to the actions taken.

✥ RANK 5: As per RANK 4, but when allies take the extra action, any skill roll associated with that action uses their full amount of attribute dice, even if that attribute has been reduced by damage.

You can hit anything with a thrown rock.
The throwing arm talent stacks with other weapon talents (like @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.GX5ym6zRrNKckQ3C]{axe fighter}) when you throw your weapons.

✥ RANK 1: Your attack rolls are modified by +1 when you use a thrown weapon or a sling.

✥ RANK 2: You can throw incredibly far. All attacks with a thrown weapon or a sling have L.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: Attacks with thrown weapons become Fast Actions. Most melee weapons can now be thrown at N as a Slow Action, they then also benefit from the bonus die from this talent. If you combine a sling and a staff into a staff sling, you can fight with that, counting as holding both weapons at the same time, without any added penalties.
✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You excel at fighting with one hand free.

✥ RANK 1: Your attack rolls are modified by +1 when you use a one-handed weapon and have your other hand free.

✥ RANK 2: Your parry actions are also modified.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 artifact die.

✥ RANK 4: Your disarm actions are also modified.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

While some people think that killing people from behind is disgraceful, you instead see it as effective.

✥ RANK 1: When you perform a sneak attack (see PHB, page 90), then if you use a light melee weapon, you may use Sleight of Hand instead of Melee to perform it. If you do use Sleight of Hand, the attack ignores your victim’s armor.

✥ RANK 2: Your Sleight of Hand sneak attacks that inflicts at least one point of damage, makes your target unable to speak or run away during his upcoming round.

✥ RANK 3: Your Sleight of Hand sneak attacks that inflicts at least one point of damage, also becomes an opposed roll vs the targets Endurance. If the roll isn’t successfully opposed (reduced to zero [x]), the target is automatically broken and suffers a critical injury. Monsters are immune.

✥ RANK 4: When attacking someone who is either unaware of your presence, or engaged in combat with a third party at A, your attacks inflict an additional +1 damage.

✥ RANK 5: Ranged weapons can now be used to make Sleight of Hand sneak attacks, as long as they are used at a maximum of S.

You throw yourself into combat without any concern for the risk involved. Requires no standing enemy at A. Target enemy at one length above weapon’s reach.

✥ RANK 1: When you move from N to A you can, as the same action, SLASH, STAB, PUNCH, or SHOVE. This is called a CHARGE (Slow Action).

✥ RANK 2: Your attack is modified by +1 when you CHARGE.

✥ RANK 3: When you CHARGE, you can add a d8 Artifact Die to the roll instead of the +1.

✥ RANK 4: You may charge as a Fast Action.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You are a rock in the heat of battle, immovable and hard to kill. This talent affects how you PARRY attacks, regardless of whether you do it with a shield or a weapon.

✥ RANK 1: When a friend within N is attacked, you can spend a WP to PARRY the attack for him. Your PARRY follows the normal rules and counts as one of your actions in the round. Any unparried damage continues to the intended target, not you.

✥ RANK 2: When you PARRY, you can immediately spend a WP to not count the PARRY against your actions in the round, making it. You can do this several times in a round, as long as you have WP to spend.

✥ RANK 3: When you PARRY successfully, you can decrease damage further by spending WP. Every point you spend decreases damage by one. You must state how many WP you use before you roll for armor.

✥ RANK 4: You may spend a WP to be allowed to parry a monster attack.

✥ RANK 5: You may combine any two ranks from this talent and doing so cost you 1 less WP.

Halflings are Small. Goblins and Halflings are considerably smaller than humans. This means that they can comfortably ride pony’s and wolves. However, all non-light 2-handed weapons impose a -1 move penalty. Heavy weapons can only be wielded using both hands and the combination 2-handed + heavy weapons cannot be used at all.

✥ RANK 1: You can spend WP in combat to avoid being hit by physical attacks . Every WP spent eliminates one [x] the attacker rolls.

✥ RANK 2: Once per QD you can take a Turn (15 minutes) to restore 1 WIT and EMP.

✥ RANK 3: Good fortune. Spend 1 WP to reroll an attribute die showing a [l], or 2 WP to reroll any other die that shows a [l], and has a detrimental effect on a [l].

✥ RANK 4: As long as you have at least 2 WP, treat all untrained skills as if they had a skill level of 1.

✥ RANK 5: As long as you have at least 3 WP, gain a +1 bonus to all skills. This effect stacks with RANK 4.

You don’t need weapons to strike down your enemy.

✥ RANK 1: All your unarmed attacks are modified by +1.

✥ RANK 2: You can headbutt your enemy. It counts as a normal unarmed attack, but it is a Fast Action.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: You may headbutt, kick or pummel your enemy as a Free Action. You may only make one such attack per turn.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You are a master shooter and fire bullets as if they were controlled by your own will.

✥ RANK 1: When you hit with a ranged weapon attack, you can spend a WP to find a weakness in your opponent’s armor or natural armor. The armor offers no protection against your attack.

✥ RANK 2: Once you have used up all your actions during the round, you can spend a WP to immediately attack again using a ranged weapon. However, said weapon must have been PREPARED earlier, and you can only do this once per round.

✥ RANK 3: When you hit with a ranged weapon attack, you can increase the damage. Every WP spent increases damage by one. You must state how many WP you use before your opponent rolls for any armor.

✥ RANK 4: If you wound with a ranged attack, you can spend WP, to add a shove or disarm effect. Each WP adds 1 [x] towards the selected effect. It costs you no WP if the target resists the effect, for instance if the target has the talents @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.pFlXU9GsjMCpRQwk]{firm grip} or @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.D11eGJDfhCk8e7ut]{steady feet}. Cannot be used on monsters.

✥ RANK 5: If you wound with a ranged attack, you can spend 1 WP to have it deal an automatic critical injury. Cannot be used on monsters.

Dragonslayer is the title given to those who seek honor and fame by killing beasts and monsters.

✥ RANK 1: All your attacks against monsters are modified by +1.

✥ RANK 2: Your attacks against monsters cause 1 additional point of damage.

✥ RANK 3: Replace +1 with a d8 Artifact Die to your roll in attacks against monsters.

✥ RANK 4: Attacks against monsters deal 2 extra points of damage, instead of 1.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You are a master of disguise and can easily assume the appearance of others. Now requires a Disguise Kit. This is a normal weighted item, that you initially get for free. However, if you lose it, you must get a new one before you can use this talent again. This requires a visit to a trading post of some kind and that you spend a WP and [[/r 2d6]] silver.

✥ RANK 1: By spending a WP and preparing for a moment, you can assume the appearance of another person, but not their voice or demeanor. The person must be of the same sex and kin as you are. Anyone who knows the person and sees you at N can discover your ruse by rolling Insight. Every extra WP you spend when you create your disguise modifies any roll to see through it by –1.

✥ RANK 2: As per RANK 1, but you can also mimic voices and demeanors. If you talk to someone who knows the person you are imitating, he can see through your disguise as per RANK 1 above.

✥ RANK 3: You can assume another person’s appearance completely, even if they are of the opposite sex or another kin. In other respects, treat this the same as per RANK 2.

✥ RANK 4: You may also apply RANK 1 to anyone other than yourself, for 1 WP per person. Does your GM only allow RANK 3 impersona-
tions of kin of your size? If so, then you may now, by using stilts (normal size object), assume the size of kins larger than yourself.
✥ RANK 5: If you use stilts as described in RANK 4, you may, given enough time to prepare, assume the size of something larger that is not even humanoid, like a giant spider or an Ent.

✥ RANK 1 (Гвирл): Гибкость и выживание Потратив 1 WP вы можете заменить один навык в проверке на другой (характеристика остается той же). Замена должна быть хотя бы немного логичной и подходящей. 
При желании вы можете выбрать хар-ку для расы, отличную от EMP.
✥ RANK 1 (Конкист): Несгибаемая воля Потратив 1 WP вы можете выкрикнуть (Fast Action) указание или приказ союзникам в N от вас. Считается, что вы помогаете им в их следующем действии (Slow Action/Fast Action) в этой сцене.

✥ RANK 2: (Гвирл): Взаимовыручка Потратив 1 WP вы можете заменить кубы помощи (вам или от вас) следующей проверки с d6 на d8.
✥ RANK 2: (Конкист): Ценность жизни Вы можете потратить остаток ваших WP (не меньше 2) чтобы заставить врага, атакующего вас, перебросить все [x] проверки (оставляя прочие кости как есть).

✥ RANK 3: (Гвирл): Адаптивность При использовании RANK 1 вы можете при желании заменить и характеристику, и навык на любой на выбор. Замена обоих стоит 2 WP.
✥ RANK 3: (Конкист): Светская подготовка При использовании навыка с RANK 3 или выше (до броска) вы можете потратить 1 WP чтобы автоматически добавить себе [x] для этой проверки. Эту проверку нельзя будет Push впоследствии.

✥ RANK 4: (Гвирл): Горькая жила Вы можете потратить 1 WP, чтобы полностью игнорировать негативные эффекты состояний Hungry, Thirsty и Cold на 1 QD.
✥ RANK 4: (Конкист): Личный пример Если любой ваш навык имеет RANK больше, чем у вашего союзника в S, этот союзник получает +1 к проверкам этого навыка.

✥ RANK 5: (Гвирл): Надежда человечества +1 к значению любой характеристики.
✥ RANK 5: (Конкист): "Слово - Власть" Потратив 1 WP, вы можете немедленно восстановить всем союзникам в пределах слышимости 1 ед. WIT или EMP на выбор (Slow Action).

You can read people like others read books.
✥ RANK 1: When you use Insight to read people you can with extra [x], get hints about that person’s motivations, background, and things that they are hiding. The GM should describe what clues you spot that make you think this.

✥ RANK 2: You get a +1 modification when you use Insight to read people or when opposing Manipulation.

✥ RANK 3: People cannot roll Insight to read you (as RANK 1). If they try to, you can lead them astray, by giving them false/made up readings.

✥ RANK 4: You can add a d8 Artifact Die when you use Insight to read people or when opposing Manipulation.

✥ RANK 5: Switch the d8 die to a d12 die. When you read people, you also discern their RANK in this talent, if any.

You have practiced with a sword in hand since you were a child. Any extra attacks count as Free Actions, and as such they do not benefit from general talents

✥ RANK 1: Your attack and PARRY rolls are modified by +1 when you fight with a sword.

✥ RANK 2: You can SLASH two enemies with your sword with a single action. Roll separately for the two attacks. If you use hidden combinations (see @JournalEntry[Advanced Close Combat]), the second attack occurs outside of the combination.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: You can slash up to three enemies with your sword with a single action. Any extra attacks still count as Free Actions, and as such they do not benefit from general talents.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You are a very smooth talker. Your words are simply irresistible. Path of influence only works if neither side has taken any hostile actions and the target must be able to clearly understand you (speak your language). It cannot be used on Monsters.
✥ RANK 1: You may spend a WP to improve the attitude of anyone towards yourself. An attitude can only be changed once and by one step, using this power and cannot be used against someone that is directly hostile, but the effect is otherwise permanent. Attitude can change from dislike, to indifferent, to friendly. If your previous actions are a cause for any dislike, a target can resist this with an Insight roll. Someone who is friendly wishes you well, and will help you, and can often take small risks to do so. Someone who is dislikes you wishes you ill, and can take small risks to harm you.
✥ RANK 2: As RANK 1, but can be directed towards someone else or towards a group, and can now also lower the attitude and can even go from dislike to openly hostile.

✥ RANK 3: As RANK 2, but you can change the attitude of a whole group at once.

✥ RANK 4: You may plant a feeling of hopelessness by taking to someone for a turn. Spend any amount of WP, the target takes this as EMP damage, resisted by an Insight roll. If this breaks the target, they cannot choose to fight, they just want to be alone. If they were already low in morale, they are likely to commit suicide, otherwise they will ponder their options and recuperate after some rest.

✥ RANK 5: As RANK 3, but up to two WP can be spent, moving the attitude up to two steps.

ЭЛЬФ: Связь багрового камня Тратя WP, вы можете впасть в медитацию (заменяет сон) на 1 QD, во время которого вас не должны тревожить. После выхода из медитации вы получаете все преимущества сна, а также можете дополнительно восстановить [[/r 1d2]] ед. одной любой характеристики и уменьшить наполовину время восстановления любой нелетальной Critical Trauma.

✥ RANK 1 (Сенхедир): Изящество При выполнении Move вы можете потратить 1 WP (перед броском) чтобы автоматически получить [x]. Эту проверку впоследствии нельзя Push.
✥ RANK 1 (Аркандар): Взрывная мощь Ваша расовая характеристика: STR. При совершении действий, зависящих от вашей физической силы, вы можете потратить 1 WP, чтобы получить бонус +3.

✥ RANK 2: (Общее):  Изменчивость Потратив 1 WP вы можете во время медитации вы можете отнять из одной любой характеристики и добавить в любую другую 1 ед. Итоговое значение характеристик не может быть ниже 2 и выше лимита для вашего класса.

✥ RANK 3: (Сенхедир): Воспоминания Во время медитации вы можете обратиться к воспоминаниям прошлого. За 1 WP вы можете спросить мастера о месте, персоне или предмете. Он расскажет легенду, последнее известное местонахождение или что-либо другое об истории или происхождении предмета вопроса. Возможно, что спрашивая о чем-то незначительном или абсолютно неизвестном вы не узнаете ничего нового.
✥ RANK 3: (Аркандар): Окровавленная воля Если вы получаете урон по STR от внешних источников, вы получаете 1 WP (не чаще 1 раза в раунд).

✥ RANK 4: (Общее): Восстановление камня При медитации вы можете потратить 1 WP чтобы получить +1 к проверкам любого атрибута на 1 день/до следующей медитации. Кроме того, вы можете исцелить свою Permanent Critical Injury, если во время медитаций суммарно потратите на это 20 WP (ведите подсчет).

✥ RANK 5: (Сенхедир): При использовании RANK 4 вы можете потратить до 3 WP / хар-ку, чтобы получить такой же бонус к проверкам. Кроме того, при вхождении в медитацию вы можете дополнительно потратить 1 WP чтобы она заняла 15 минут и вместо обычных бонусов полностью восстановила AGI (все еще считается медитацией).
✥ RANK 5: (Аркандар): Багровый перегруз Потратив 3 WP, вы можете немедленно совершить (Slow Action | Charge) @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.1opXrdpFFhh95EBe]{Melee Charge} или совершить обычную атаку оружием Fast Action; этим действием вы наносите удвоенный урон оружия. После совершения действия вы получаете 1 ед. урона STR. Кроме того, медитация полностью восстанавливает все ваши характеристики.

When others try to affect you, you are as immovable as a mighty oak in the wind.

✥ RANK 1: Your Insight roll is modified by +1 when someone attempts to MANIPULATE you.

✥ RANK 2: You can add a d8 Artifact Die to your roll when someone MANIPULATES you.

✥ RANK 3: You cannot be MANIPULATED.

✥ RANK 4: You may roll Insight as a fast reaction to halve the Power Level you feel from a magical effect, round down. You get no roll if you were the source of the spell.

✥ RANK 5: RANK 4 is now a free reaction once per round. You now automatically succeed to resist all spells that can be resisted by rolling Insight.

You recognize patterns in tracks, injuries, movement, and attacks. The longer the hunt continues, the fewer surprises remain to the quarry.

HUNT TARGET: A Hunt Target is a specific monster, a pack of creatures of the same kind, or an unknown creature responsible for the evidence being investigated. To designate a Hunt Target, you must have seen it, examined a fresh track or victim, obtained a sample, or received a sufficiently detailed account. You may have only one Hunt Target at a time. Changing it outside combat takes one Turn.

STUDIED QUARRY: A Hunt Target becomes Studied after you spend at least one Turn examining relevant evidence and succeed with an appropriate skill roll. Use Scouting for tracks and attack sites, Survival for territory and behavior, Lore for records and supernatural nature, Healing for anatomy and remains, or Crafting for mechanisms, shells, and artificial creatures. For every additional [x], you may ask the GM one practical question about the quarry. The answer must be concrete and useful.

✥ RANK 1: When you make a roll to study the Hunt Target, you may spend WP after seeing the result. Each WP spent is converted into one automatic [x].

✥ RANK 2: After successfully studying the Hunt Target, spend one Turn and 1 to 3 WP. For each WP spent, place one d8 in a shared Hunt Pool. Any party member may expend one die from the pool after making a roll directly against the Hunt Target or one of its abilities, then roll and add that die to the result. No more than one Hunt Pool die may be added to the same roll. Unused dice disappear when the hunt ends, the Hunt Target changes, or one day passes.

✥ RANK 3: When the GM rolls on the Studied Quarry's monster attack table, you may spend 1 WP after seeing the result. The GM rerolls the attack, and the new result must be used. You may use this effect once per round.

✥ RANK 4: After the Studied Quarry has used a particular monster attack or special ability at least once, you may spend 1 WP to declare that attack analyzed. Until the encounter ends, choose one appropriate benefit against it: you get d10 to DODGE, PARRY, or another resistance roll; its direct Damage to you is reduced by 1 (no less than 1); its Poison or Disease Virulence is reduced by 2; its Fear Attack produces one fewer [x]; or the duration of a condition it causes is halved. Only one attack may be analyzed at a time. Spend 1 WP to replace it with another previously observed attack. You can spend additional WP to give the same benefit to an equal amount of your allies.

✥ RANK 5: At the start of a round, you may spend 1 WP. Until the end of that round, whenever the Studied Quarry rolls on its monster attack table, the GM rolls twice and you choose which result is used. This effect may be combined with ranks 3 and 4.

You know how to steer rafts and boats over unknown waters. All modifier/Artifact dice from this talent also applies when taking the survey the lands action from a boat while in a water hex.

✥ RANK 1: Your Survival roll is modified by +1 when you LEAD THE WAY at sea (see @JournalEntry[Journeys]).

✥ RANK 2: Life at sea is soothing to you. A QD spent LEADING THE WAY on a boat counts as REST for you.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: As long as you continuously succeed to lead the way at sea, your party of adventurers may travel up to two extra hexagons this QD.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d12 die.

You practice an unorthodox close combat fighting style.
✥ RANK 1: When you shove, grapple or break free, you can spend WP which are automatically turned into extra [x]. You may even roll first and spend WP after you see how the roll goes.
✥ RANK 2: You may spend 1 WP to roll your full number of dice, even when damaged. The effect lasts a day or until you are broken.
✥ RANK 3: When rolling for Endurance, you can spend WP which are automatically turned into extra [x]. You may even roll first and spend WP after you see how the roll goes.

✥ RANK 4: If you are broken, you may immediately spend WP to not be able to count as broken or unconscious, and keep your
full allotment of actions, for a number of rounds equal to the WP spent. During these rounds, you roll your full number of attribute dice (even when damaged) and may reduce any damage received by 1. It does not protect you from any critical injuries, so those can still kill you. Each critical hit taken also reduces the duration by 1 round. It doesn’t hinder you from pushing any rolls, but only gain WP from that reduce an attribute.

✥ RANK 5: You may spend WP to enhance your STR or AGI by up to 3 points each for a turn (15 minutes). When the turn ends, any damage taken will spill over to your regular attributes, but will not reduce you below 1.

Вы считаете, что нет ничего важнее, чем забота о будущих поколениях. Вы не можете изучить этот талант при создании персонажа.

✥ RANK 1: Ваш следующий персонаж получает дополнительное очко навыка при генерации. Ваш базовый опыт увеличивается на 1.

✥ RANK 2: Ваш следующий персонаж получает дополнительное очко таланта при генерации. Ваш базовый опыт дополнительно увеличивается на 2.

✥ RANK 3: Ваш следующий персонаж получает два дополнительных очка таланта при генерации. Ваш базовый опыт дополнительно увеличивается на 3.

✥ RANK 4: Ваш следующий персонаж получает дополнительное очко таланта при генерации. Ваш базовый опыт дополнительно увеличивается на 4.

✥ RANK 5: Ваш следующий персонаж получает четыре дополнительных очка таланта при генерации и может вкладывать очки навыков в любые навыки до уровня 4. Ваш базовый опыт дополнительно увеличивается на 5.

Your horse (or another riding animal) is your closest friend and companion, and will help you if you are in trouble.

✥ RANK 1: If you spend a WP when you are Broken (see @JournalEntry[Damage & Recovery]), your horse will stay by your side and defend you. The horse will attack any opponents that attempt to attack or move you.

✥ RANK 2: Your horse can help you get up on your feet when you are Broken. For every WP you spend, you recover one point of the attribute that has been reduced to zero. You cannot use this effect if you are not Broken. An Orc may treat the first WP spent as if two.

✥ RANK 3: Your horse can kick opponents when you are in the saddle. If you spend a WP when it is your turn to act in the round, the horse can also attack in close combat, right after your action. Roll normally for the horse’s attack.

COMMENT: If your mount is killed, you can buy or tame a new one and use your talent with the new mount.

✥ RANK 4: When you are not with your mount, you may spend a WP to add a d12 to any roll that would likely take you closer to being together again. It can be used against any obstacle that gets in your way of returning, as long as there is not a much simpler way of returning to it (like taking a flee action).

✥ RANK 5: You can communicate (whistle/neigh) with your mount perfectly even on D, that for others looks more like a telepathic bond. Have your animal do any action for 1 WP. The action may be long and take time, like “get the rope from the back of the wagon and wait for me on the west side of the building”.

You are a master at surviving in the wilderness. Read more about journeys in @JournalEntry[Journeys].

✥ RANK 1: When you FORAGE, HUNT, or LEAD THE WAY, you succeed automatically if you spend a WP. You can roll first and spend the point if you fail.

✥ RANK 2: When rolling to endure cold (see @JournalEntry[Conditions]), you automatically succeed if you spend a WP. You can roll first and spend the point if you fail.

✥ RANK 3: By spending a WP, you don’t need to eat or drink during one full day.

✥ RANK 4: For 1 WP per QD, you may treat difficult ground as if it was not.

✥ RANK 5: You may spend WP to add [x] to any skill roll, as long as you are outdoors in a forest. You may do this after seeing the results of the roll.

You are skilled at using weapons and shields to protect yourself in close combat. Note that Free Actions no longer can benefit from talents. So, you have to call out if you make a free parry or if you spend a Fast Action.

✥ RANK 1: You get one free PARRY every round of combat. The extra PARRY does not count as one of your actions in the round.

✥ RANK 2: You get a +1 bonus to all PARRIES.

✥ RANK 3: You can PARRY an unlimited number of times in the same round of combat, but only once against the same attack. Only the first PARRY counts towards your actions in the round.

✥ RANK 4: When you don’t parry an attack, you may add any held shield’s Item Dice to your Armor Rating. So, if you dodge, you may add them. If you also use the “Cannot parry arrows” module: You may now deflect projectiles with a weapon as a parry. Projectiles are however treated as stab attacks (-2 penalty, or -4 without the parrying attribute). You are allowed to use Free Actions to parry arrows, even if you use the “Free Action limitation” module.

✥ RANK 5: You can add a d8 Artifact Die when you parry. Bonuses from defender now applies to free parries, even if you use the “Free Action limitation” module.

You are lethal with a knife in hand.

✥ RANK 1: Your attack rolls are modified by +1 when you fight with a knife or a dagger.

✥ RANK 2: You can STAB as a Fast Action using a knife or a dagger.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: You can take a -2 penalty to a knife/dagger attack to have it ignore the targets armor.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

Вы чувствуете в себе возможности для многогранного развития. Изучая этот талант на RANK 1, выберите Profession Talent другой профессии, который будет связан с этим талантом. You try to understand the world in a proto-scientific form, learning to bend the elements of the land into new forms, by experimentation, research and studies.

✥ RANK 1: Ваши гранаты становятся намного точнее в поражении целей. Вы получаете модификатор +1 к проверкам Marksmanship, когда метаете бомбы и игнорируете модификатор выбора точки метания.

✥ RANK 2: При метании бомб вы выбираете, какой характеристикой и навыком ее бросать (STR/AGI и Might/Marksmanship). В случае разлета определяйте случайное место попадания дважды, выбирая лучший результат. Кроме того, шанс взрыва бомбы в ваших руках меняется на 1 / [[/r 1d6]].

✥ RANK 3: Броски взрывчатки получают модификатор +d8 к проверкам Marksmanship (заменяя +1). Вы можете метать взрывчатку с помощью Fast Action.

✥ RANK 4: Брошенные вами бомбы всегда взрываются ровно в установленный момент (если вы того хотите) и не могут случайно взорваться у вас в руках. От ваших взрывов невозможно уклониться.

✥ RANK 5: Метая бомбу, вы получаете 1 гарантированный [x] попадания, к которому добавляете результат своей проверки (или можете метнуть бомбу на 1 дистанцию дальше максимума без гарантированного [x]). Кроме того, при взрыве бомбы она всегда наносят дополнительно 1 урон, а все ваши бомбы увеличивают свое свойство Взрывчатка на 1.

Bashing heads in with a sturdy warhammer is your idea of a good day in the Forbidden Lands. Now also applies to attacks with a spiked weapon.

✥ RANK 1: You get +1 to all attack rolls with a BLUNT melee weapon.

✥ RANK 2: All attacks with a BLUNT weapon inflict at least 1 point of damage, even if the target’s armor absorbs all damage.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: Halve the targets rolled amount of armor.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

It takes a lot for you to lose your grip on your weapon.

✥ RANK 1: DISARMING you requires an extra [x] – that is, two [x] for a one-handed weapon and three [x] for a two-handed weapon.

✥ RANK 2: DISARMING you requires two extra [x] – three [x] for a one-handed weapon and four [x] for a two-handed weapon.

✥ RANK 3: You cannot be DISARMED.

✥ RANK 4: You may hold a two-handed melee weapon in one hand, but opponents CAN disarm such a held weapon from you, if they roll 2 [x].

✥ RANK 5: You cannot be disarmed while holding a two-handed weapon in one hand.
✥ RANK 1-5: You can cast RANK 1-5 spells from the Vermin discipline.

✥ RANK 1: Вы можете сменить одно Light оружие на другое не тратя действий. Кроме того, вы можете перебросить полученный результат @UUID[RollTable.7XUDKc1dq6rZTJJp]{Пороховая осечка!}

✥ RANK 2: Вы можете выстрелить один раз в стычке за Free Action. Вы можете двигаться во время перезарядки оружия (в два раза медленее обычной скорости).

✥ RANK 3: Один раз за стычку вы можете уменьшить время перезарядки одного вашего разряженного огнестрельного оружия на (10 * [x] проверки Sleight of Hand) секунд (+d8 для этой проверки). 

✥ RANK 4: Как RANK 2, но вы можете выстрелить дополнительный раз за стычку за Free Action (итого 2). Вы можете двигаться во время перезарядки оружия (с обычной скоростью).

✥ RANK 5: Единожды за партию вы можете моментально перезарядить одно ваше разряженное оружие со свойством @INFO[Перезарядка].

 

Не забывайте, что любые Free Action не могут получать бонусов от ваших талантов (прим.: Free Action от этого таланта не получит бонусов @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.JzvlxFpZo2JZEi3t]{Sharpshooter})

✥ RANK 1: You can spend WP to designate a person or a creature as your prey. Your prey must be within line of sight, or there must be a scent to follow. The number of WP you spend equals the number of days that you can follow your prey’s scent. In combat, all your attacks against your prey get a +1 bonus per WP spent, until the creature is Broken or until you choose to let your prey go.

✥ RANK 2: You may spend 1 WP to ignore becoming Cold. You may do this after you have seen the result of any roll. If combined with @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.8UjUBWWGjuF5AKgQ]{Path of the Forest} RANK 2, you instead become immune to cold.

✥ RANK 3: You may designate a whole group as your prey. The whole group must be within line of sight, or have a scent to follow. Count this as if you at the same time would have a designated prey of each individual target, but any attack bonuses against them are halved, round down.

✥ RANK 4: You gain a bonus die to all rolls when you are outdoors in a forest or dark forest hex.

✥ RANK 5: You gain an 2 bonus die per WP against your designated prey.

You study a monster to learn which organ must be broken, which limb must be ruined, and where its armor opens.

HUNT TARGET: A Hunt Target is a specific monster, a pack of creatures of the same kind, or an unknown creature responsible for the evidence being investigated. To designate a Hunt Target, you must have seen it, examined a fresh track or victim, obtained a sample, or received a sufficiently detailed account. You may have only one Hunt Target at a time. Changing it outside combat takes one Turn.

STUDIED QUARRY: A Hunt Target becomes Studied after you spend at least one Turn examining relevant evidence and succeed with an appropriate skill roll. Use Scouting for tracks and attack sites, Survival for territory and behavior, Lore for records and supernatural nature, Healing for anatomy and remains, or Crafting for mechanisms, shells, and artificial creatures. For every additional [x], you may ask the GM one practical question about the quarry. The answer must be concrete and useful.

✥ RANK 1: When you hit the Studied Quarry with an attack, you may spend 1 WP. Its natural Armor is ignored by that attack. Artificial armor, shields, magical barriers, and cover still apply.

✥ RANK 2: When your attack deals at least 1 Damage to the Studied Quarry after Armor, you may spend 1 WP. Until the start of your next turn, the first ally to attack the same quarry gains a d10 to the attack and ignores 2 points of its natural Armor. The effect ends after the first eligible attack, whether it succeeds or fails.

✥ RANK 3: When your attack deals at least 1 Damage to the Studied Quarry, you may spend 2 WP to break a specific body part. Choose one suitable effect.
Attack Organ: One monster attack linked to that part suffers a three-die penalty, or its direct Damage is reduced by 1.
Movement Organ: The quarry loses one form of movement such as flight, burrowing, swimming, climbing, or a special leap. Ordinary ground movement may instead be limited to one zone per action.
Defensive Part: Its natural Armor is reduced by 2.
Only one broken part from this RANK may affect the same quarry at a time. The effect normally lasts until the encounter ends.

✥ RANK 4: When the Studied Quarry declares a monster attack or attempts to leave the encounter, you may spend 2 WP and immediately make one free attack if it is within reach. If your attack deals at least 1 Damage, reduce the declared attack's Damage to 1 and cancel all additional conditions and movement it would cause, or stop the attempted escape or special movement. The monster attack still occurs. This effect may be used once per round, and RANK 1 may be activated on the same attack.

✥ RANK 5: When you deal Damage to a part already broken by RANK 3, you may spend 2 WP to destroy or sever it permanently. Choose one effect:
-remove the linked monster attack from the table for the rest of the encounter, rerolling it whenever selected;
-permanently remove the linked form of movement;
-reduce natural Armor by a further 2;
-disable the linked special ability completely.
You may use this effect once per encounter. You may also combine any two ranks of this Path in the same attack, reducing their total WP cost by 1, to a minimum of 1 WP.

Not even the horrors that lurk in the Forbidden Lands scare you.
When you gain fearless, you may select to roll Might instead of Insight to reduce fear damage.

✥ RANK 1: You can roll an Insight roll as “armor” against fear attacks – each [x] rolled eliminates one [x] rolled in the fear attack. The Insight roll does not count as an action. You may choose to roll Might instead of Insight.

✥ RANK 2: You can choose to have damage from a fear attack decrease your EMP instead of your WIT.

✥ RANK 3: You are immune to fear attacks.

✥ RANK 4: Once per encounter, when a monster uses a fear attack, you gain a WP.

✥ RANK 5: Your allies within N counts as having a RANK in fearless, one higher than they otherwise have.

You have done a lot of less clean jobs in your life. This has turned you more resistant to bugs, smells and toxins.

✥ RANK 1: You get a +1 modification when you roll Endurance to resist poison or disease or when someone rolls Healing to help you against them.

✥ RANK 2: Bad smells, like from certain monsters, no longer affect you. Также: х2 ко времени действия всех состояний мытья.

✥ RANK 3: You can add a d8 Artifact Die when you roll Endurance to resist poison or disease or when someone rolls Healing to help you against them. Также: пока вы имеете любую степень вымытости, вы можете перебросить проверку против яда или болезни.

✥ RANK 4: You are immune to any limited effect from poisons, and you automatically resist/stop any full effects after a turn under their effect. You never have to roll Endurance against becoming infected by a disease more than once per QD. Также: Virulence болезней против вас уменьшается на 3 пока у вас есть какая-либо степень вымытости.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d12 die. Также: вы не получаете состояний мытья хуже "@UUID[Item.GVxtPzddSwesDYRF]{Немытый}" - грязь и пот просто отказываются к вам прилипать.

You have learned to endure pain that would make others lose their minds.

✥ RANK 1: If you take a single point of damage from an attack, you don’t lose your attack in the same step (see @JournalEntry[Advanced Close Combat]).

OR

✥ RANK 1: If your STR is reduced to exactly 0, and does no overshoot, you ignore 1 damage and thus stay at 1 STR. This also 
makes you NOT take a critical injury. If it prevents damage from pushing a roll, it also does not provide WP. It can trigger up to once per encounter (every 15 minutes).

✥ RANK 2: You never lose your own attack because of pain.

OR

✥ RANK 2: As RANK 1, but it is no longer limited to only once per encounter. 

✥ RANK 3: You recover one lost point of AGI, WIT or EMP for every point of damage to STR that you suffer.

✥ RANK 4: Once each encounter, you may immediately gain one Slow Action and one Fast Action at your full amount of attribute dice if an enemy breaks you. These actions interrupt the normal initiative order. You do not count as broken until after these actions, but you do suffer any critical injuries before taking them. You do not get to act if you suffer a critical injuey that immediately kills you.

✥ RANK 5: When broken in STR or AGI, you can roll Endurance during your next round, if successful recover that many attribute points.

You are adept at running.
✥ RANK 1: You get a +1 modification when you roll Move to jump, run really fast, flee or because of rough terrain.
If someone wants to retreat or flee from you, and nothing can hinder you from pursuing, add a -1 penalty to the enemy roll.
✥ RANK 2: If you spend a Slow Action to run, you may traverse two zones. (In very open terrain, your superior movement could make you automatically win flee or opposed flee rolls.)

✥ RANK 3: You can add a d8 Artifact Die when you roll for Move to jump, run really fast, flee, because of rough terrain. If someone wants to retreat or flee from you, and nothing can hinder you from pursuing, add another -1 penalty to the enemy roll, (to a total of -2).

✥ RANK 4: Gain one free run action per turn, i.e. usable once every 15 minutes.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d12 die. If someone wants to retreat or flee from you, and nothing can hinder you from pursuing, add another -1 penalty to the enemy roll, (to a total of -3).

You are are a skilled engineer and can build advanced constructions in your stronghold.

✥ RANK 1: You can build advanced functions in your stronghold. Added to RANK 1: When you mine, chop wood, or extract other resources from the land, you gain an extra resource per QD pf work.

✥ RANK 2: You get a +1 modification when you build a function in a stronghold. Added to RANK 2: The modification also applies when you survey the land and when you roll Crafting rolls to break constructions and items.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die. You may now supervise any number of simultaneous constructions. Any constructions you supervise may benefit from your RANK in builder.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d10 die with a d12 die. You may now supervise any number of simultaneous constructions. Any constructions you supervise may benefit from your RANK in builder. 

Builders now also have a knack for knowing where to search for valuable parts of the land, like a prospector of sorts, and can easier spot the weakest parts of a construction.

Added to RANK 2-5: The gained +1 modification and Artifact die also applies when you survey the land and when you roll Crafting rolls to mine, chop wood, or extract other resources from the land or if/when you would break any constructions and items.

When you are Broken, you can choose to unleash a primal rage upon the world. On your turn in the next round, you recover as many points in the attribute that has been decreased to zero as your RANK in BERSERKER. You must immediately attack the nearest opponent in close combat, and keep fighting until you are Broken (again) or until all opponents within sight have been Broken. During your rage, you are immune to any attempts to MANIPULATE you and all your close combat attacks do one extra point of damage. If Broken during a BERSERKER rage, you cannot use this talent.

Added to RANK 5: You can now restore one more point than available in the attribute. Any excessive points are lost when the rage ends.

Holding and playing an instrument with both hands makes the first WP spent count as two, or three if you are a Half-elf.

Your beautiful voice can captivate any audi-ence, and can even torment the listeners if you so choose.

✥ RANK 1: By spending WP and singing, you can draw the attention of everyone in N to yourself for a few minutes. They stop what they are doing, and any Scouting roll they make is modified negatively by the number of WP you spend. This has no effect in combat.

✥ RANK 2: As per RANK 1, but you can also persuade your audience to pay for your singing. They will pay what they can, up to a number of silver pieces equal to the number of WP you spend.

✥ RANK 3: You can sing so powerfully that your song cuts into the ears of any listeners within S. Your song causes 1 point of damage to STR per WP you spend. You can distribute the damage across as many opponents as you want. The targets may attempt to resist the effect by rolling for Insight – each [x] rolled negates 1 point of damage. No effect against monsters.

✥ RANK 4: As RANK 3 but you deal a minimum of 1 damage to one target. You can now target Monsters, but can then only deal them 1 damage per action.

✥ RANK 5: You may as a sneak attack against targets at S, sing a soft lullaby that deals 1 damage to WIT to up to a number of targets equal to the number of WP spent, they all also become sleepy. You may keep singing by spending more WP during the following turns. Any targets that are broken simply falls asleep. The targets will not recall hearing the song and will treat everything they see as if it was just a dream. If they however see anything hostile, like drawn weapons, or any one at A, they will immediately snap out of the dream-state. Monsters takes no damage from this song, but will ignore non-hostile actions while the song lasts. Monsters will recall everything, as if it was not a dream, as soon as the song ends

The RANK of this talent determines which spells you can use. Read more about magic in @JournalEntry[Magic].

✥ RANK 1: You can cast RANK 1 spells from the Elemental Magic discipline.

✥ RANK 2: You can also cast RANK 2 spells from the ElementalMagic discipline.

✥ RANK 3: You can also cast RANK 3 spells from the Elemental Magic discipline.

✥ RANK 4/5: You can also cast RANK 4/5 spells from the Elemental Magic discipline

Все RANK этого таланта работают применительно к одноручному огнестрельному оружию.

✥ RANK 1: Вы точно знаете как показать свое превосходство в любой стычке и перетянуть внимание на себя. Вы можете уменьшить навык любой проверки, направленной против вас или ваших союзников на значение, равное кол-ву [x] вашей проверки Sleight of Hand. Учитывайте, что это может расцениваться как угроза.

✥ RANK 2: Вы больше не получаете негативных модификаторов для последующих выстрелов из оружия со свойством @INFO[Многозарядное]

✥ RANK 3: Вы можете PARRY атаки ближнего боя выстрелом из оружия с весом не более Light. Каждый [x] нейтрализует [x] направленной на вас атаки.

✥ RANK 4: Как RANK 2, но следующие выстрелы после первого из оружия со свойством @INFO[Многозарядное] получают кумулятивный модификатор +1 (+3 если вы промахнулись предыдущим выстрелом).

✥ RANK 5: Один раз за партию вы можете заявить выстрел Крещендо по цели, находящейся в на радиусе стрельбы на одну ступень меньше максимального для вашего оружия - вы не совершаете бросков, ваша атака автоматически попадает в цель и оставляет ее без сознания. Кроме того, выберите одно оружие весом не более Normal (в т.ч. 2H). Для него действуют все RANK этого таланта.

You have mastered the art of pulling fish from rivers and lakes. You need a net, a rod, or some other piece of fishing equipment. Read more about fishing in @JournalEntry[Journeys].

✥ RANK 1: Your roll for Survival is modified by +1 when you FISH.

✥ RANK 2: Fishing sets you at ease. A QD spent FISHING counts as RESTING for you.

✥ RANK 3: The amount of FISH you catch is doubled.

✥ RANK 4: You make sure your food doubles as fish bait. You may add your food die to the roll, adding any [x], but also risk reducing your available food.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the +1 modifier with a d10 die.

You are one with the feral creatures of the world and can assume their attributes or even take their form. The RANK of this talent determines which spells you can use. Read more about magic in @JournalEntry[Magic].

✥ RANK 1: You can cast RANK 1 spells from the Shapeshifting discipline.

✥ RANK 2: You can cast RANK 1 and RANK 2 spells from the Shapeshifting discipline.

✥ RANK 3: You can cast RANK 1, 2 and 3 spells from the Shapeshifting discipline.

✥ RANK 4: You can also cast RANK 4 spells from the Shapeshifting discipline

✥ RANK 5: You can also cast RANK 5 spells from the Shapeshifting discipline

The hairs on the back of your neck stand up when enemies lurk in the bushes.

✥ RANK 1: Your Scouting roll is modified by +1 when an enemy tries to ambush you or performs a sneak attack (see @JournalEntry[Combat]).

✥ RANK 2: When you spot an ambush or a sneak attack, you also see how many the attackers are, what kin they belong to, and what weapons they use.

✥ RANK 3: Replace +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die to your Scouting roll when you try to spot an ambush or a sneak attack.

✥ RANK 4: When you spot an ambush or sneak attack, you do it in such a way, so that you may ambush or sneak attack the opponent.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d12 die.

You have an animal as a trusted companion. Pick the type of animal yourself from the list of animals under the Items tab, and give your animal a name. You cannot choose a riding animal.

✥ RANK 1: Your animal can Scouting for you. You can spend a WP to send the animal ahead to check out a place nearby, and the animal will warn you if there is a threat there.

✥ RANK 2: Your animal can help you when you are Broken (see @JournalEntry[Damage & Recovery]). Every WP you spend recovers one point of the attribute that has reached zero. You cannot use this effect when you are not Broken. An Orc may treat the first WP spent as if two.

✥ RANK 3: You can send your animal to fight for you. If you spend a WP when it is your turn to fight, the animal will also fight and follow your orders for one round, at your turn in the initiative order. Roll normally for the animal’s attacks.

COMMENT: Your animal will protect itself if it is attacked, but if you want it to fight for you, you need RANK 3 of this talent. If your animal dies, you can tame a new one (read more on Animal Handling in @JournalEntry[Skills]). Once you have tamed an animal, you can choose to use it as a new companion. You keep your RANK of PATH OF THE BEAST.

✥ RANK 4: Your animal always helps you when you are Scouting, as long as it can alert you, you may spend WP for extra [x] on the Scouting roll, after seeing the result.

✥ RANK 5: As RANK 3, but your animal continues to fight until it is broken or you call it off.

Your mount is fast like the wind.

✥ RANK 1: For every WP you spend, your mount can move one extra hex square in a QD (see @JournalEntry[Journeys]), in normal terrain. Difficult terrain requires two WP per extra hex square.

✥ RANK 2: When you are mounted, you can spend a WP to escape from combat without rolling dice (see @JournalEntry[Combat]). All other limitations apply.

✥ RANK 3: You can coax your mount into running at breakneck speed for a short period of time. Every WP you spend increases the mount’s Movement Rate (see @JournalEntry[Combat]) one step, but only during one round.

✥ RANK 4: When you use RANK 1 of this talent, it affects all allies you are riding with.

✥ RANK 5: When riding, you may spend WP to add [x] to any skill roll, as long as you can justify why doing the skill while as one with your mount, would do you good. You may do this after seeing the results of the roll.

system.ingredient: See Epic Magic (Epic Magic ingredients do not increase Power Level)
system.description:
Special: Epic Magic.

This is an Epic Spell, see the description for those in this booklet. Each PL requires an ingredient. This ritual permanently alters the ecosystem in the current map hex you stand in. A wonder can from time to time occur naturally as long as some of the ingredient pre-conditions can be met.

Temperature change: The area becomes warmer or colder than usually. This could mean that Spring/Fall would counts as Summer or Winter and so on. Cost: 2 per temperature change.

Strange weather: The area becomes almost constantly shrouded in fog, or suffers constant rain, strong winds or any other weather phenomenon. Cost: 1 unless the phenomenon is more unusual, like thunder storms, in that case increase the cost to 2.

Teeming with life: The area is teeming with life. Gain a bonus modifier to fishing or hunting rolls. Cost: 1 per modifier.

Bountiful lands: The area grows rich with vegetables. Gain a bonus modifier to forage rolls. Cost: 1 per modifier.

Forest growth: The area grows very rich with trees. Cost: 1 to increase the amount from none to sparse, to forest, to dark forest. It takes around 1 month for the forest to fully grow.

Uncommon fauna: Select a type of herb, animal, monster or tree. These will to some degree start to inhabit the hex, but will still be rare. Cost: 1 for natural types and 3 for more fantastical or magical types. If the type if hostile, 1 point of the cost is reduced to corruption.

Corrupted fauna: Animals and to some degree plants in the area are extra hostile or fearful. This effect counts as 1 point of corruption.

Dead lands: Hunting, fishing and foraging rolls suffer a -2 penalty. This effect counts as 1 point of corruption.

Haunted grounds: The dead do not tend to stay dead on these grounds. They rise as somewhat mindless undead. This effect counts as 1 point of corruption.

Your song can summon servant creatures from the very rock. This golem obeys your orders during the present QD, then it turns into an inanimate statue. The golem can only perform basic tasks and it must remain within your view. The stats of the golem depend on the PL. PL 1 creates a small creature with STR 2, AGI 1, and stone skin with an Armor Rating of 3. Every increase in PL increases both STR and Armor Rating by 1. You can also use the PL to create more golems at the same time – every increase in PL creates an additional golem. For example, PL 4 allows you to create three golems with a STR of 3 and Armor Rating 4. This spell can only be used in the terrain type MOUNTAIN or in a CAVE.

This spell creates a dormant clone body of yourself. If you ever would die in this realm, before the duration is up, your consciousness will transfer to your clone and you will wake up after a QD, with no physical critical injuries and fully healed attributes. You keep any mental horror injuries and must roll for one new from the traumatic experience of death. You can have more than one clone of yourself, your consciousness will be transferred to the nearest one. If you add a PL, you can wake up after just 1 turn, and at 2 or more PL you will wake up in your clone immediately.
Your song can wither stone, allowing you to break down walls and fortifications within N range. The thickness of the barrier determines the PL required – every half-meter requires one PL.

This ritual takes a QD and alleviates a permanent critical injury. If used within a turn (15 minutes) of it happening, the effect is immediate and can then even reverse death without any negative side effects. If the stump is lost, to badly damaged or cannot be attached within a turn, you can magically form a new limb. Even though it forms immediately, it takes a while to adjust to it and it will be effectively unusable for [[/r 2d6]] days -1 day per PL. This second usage cannot reverse death.

You can make hot, liquid stone or metal shape itself and solidify in any roughcut form you want. Up to one cubic meter of material can be shaped per PL. The molded mass remembers and retains the desired shape when it cools and becomes solid. More precise shapes require a CRAFTING roll and molding weapons requires the SMITH talent. You can use this spell to form ten balls of stone for the spell @UUID[Compendium.world.spells.Item.ZePdXZ6Q4VU52R5W]{Magma Cascade}.

Your body takes a more liquid form during the duration. During this time, you can squeeze through any cracks and will take a maximum of 1 STR damage from any edged or pointed attack. All your melee weapon attacks gain near reach. You sadly have no armor rating while in this form.
You can use this spell instead of making an animal handling check against an animal with a STR no higher than 2x PL. No effect against monsters.
You can heal damage to STR or AGI by laying your hands on the wounded. You immediately heal a number of points equal to the PL. This spell does not affect critical injuries. You cannot heal yourself.

This spell calls a meteor from the skies to strike a target hex. It is however very imprecise and at first ignores your directions, falling towards a random hex, [[/r 1d6]] hexes away from you in a random direction. Each PL then refocuses the meteor moving it one hex closer to the target hex. A random area in the target hex is then utterly obliterated by the impact and fires spreads. The resulting crater will contain 1 unit of meteorite iron, but never any elven rubies. The spell is rarely used by the dwarves, as some incidents in the past caused the loss of too many dwarven lives.

system.ingredient: A living pupa which is eaten
system.description: You can change your own appearance, voice, and smell into those of another living creature between half and double your original size. You do not acquire the creature’s attributes or language, even if it seems that way to others – it is only an illusion. Everyone who sees you can make an INSIGHT roll to understand that it is an illusion. Each additional PL adds –1 to the INSIGHT roll. A person within A range who touches you immediately realizes that it is an illusion.

This spell can lift a very large iron object and move it up to a zone. The action is itself kind of slow, so it cannot really be used to deal damage to other targets, unless they are immobilized. One of its uses could be to destroy a portcullis or metal door.

This powerful ritual tears a hole in the veil between worlds and opens a path between them. This is a very risky undertaking, since you run the risk of running into all sorts of demons and other malevolent creatures on the other side – perhaps you can use them for your own purposes, but it is just as likely they will attempt to use you for their own. Or perhaps devour you. The spell @UUID[Compendium.world.spells.Item.JNkvTlEQ9oIBxYjz]{Bind Demon} (see blood magic) is very useful here. The details are up to the GM. Another use for this spell is creating a new PORTAL on the other side, which can lead you anywhere you want in the Forbidden Lands.

system.ingredient: A mirror or polished piece of metal
system.description:
Special: Power Word.

Anyone looking at you sees a blur of multiple copies of you within arm’s reach of one another. When you are subjected to an attack, the target rolls scouting, on a hit they target you, but on a failure, they target one of your mirror images. Multiple attacks or area of effect attacks can target several mirror images all at once. Each image that would suffers a damage or any detrimental effect (like being disarmed) instead vanishes. You gain one mirror image per PL.

Can only be cast in the outdoors. Burning volcanic cinders starts to single down from the sky, targeting anything within L range from a designated point within range. Anything within the area becomes illuminated for a turn (15 minutes). Roll a die per PL for all human sized objects in the area, if the cinders can land on flammables like distilled alcohol, gunpowder or so, they catch fire/explode on any rolled x, and if they are not easily flammable, then they can instead be brushed of with a slow action, that is enough to avoid having the smoldering cinders deal any continuous damage. The spell will likely also start random fires in the area. One random building/function per PL catches fire. If you use the “Arson event” module under the Stronghold section, that can be used for inspiration for the fires.

You can make a metal armor antimagnetic so that it repels weapons containing metal, including arrows with metal arrowheads. A negative modification equal to the PL is added to all attacks with metal weapons.

Must be cast on a sleeping target within range. They must then succeed an insight roll with a penalty equal to the PL or be left trapped in a nightmare for as long as you want. The spell will break if you die. On the outside they will act as if catatonic, and will die if they don’t receive continuous care.

You curse a creature to haunt the lands as a “restless dead” a few weeks after its death. You gain no control over the undead, in fact it will most likely resent you for doing this. It will usually be mentally stuck to the general area (about L range) of where it did rise and will more or less lose any ability to make long term memories, becoming demented and confused. Added PL can increase the power of the undead as the @UUID[Compendium.world.spells.Item.J20fdqCLWv7squ6x]{Raise the Dead} spell, or for 2 added PL raise the cursed being as a ghost. Each PL also negates the healing benefit of one rest or 1 PL of magical healing. If the target receives enough rest or healing to reduce this to zero, before they die and rise as an undead, the curse will be broken.

Special: Power Word.

You can use this spell to foresee your next attack. Add 3 dice per PL to the next slash, stab, punch/kick or shoot attack before the end of your next round.

system.ingredient: Blanket of insects (optional; consumed if available)
system.description: Insects form a protective barrier around you. Ignore the next PL of STR damage you would receive. It will not protect against damage from pushing rolls. The spell depletes at double rate, if possible, if it takes damage from fire, cold, acid or lightning. This spell can at any-time, during your round, be dismissed to create a blanket of insects.

system.ingredient: Piece of ice or a fistful of snow (optional)
system.description: The spell reinforces your armor with a hardened layer of ice. This grants your armor a [[/r 1d8]] Artifact Die, and your Armor Rating also increases to a minimum of 6 during the spell’s duration. Increasing the PL by one can upgrade the Artifact Die to a [[/r 1d10]].

system.ingredient: A resource roll for drinkable water.
system.description: You heal 1 point of STR, AGI, WIT and EMP when this QD ends. You may spend additional PL to speed up the progress. At one additional PL, you heal after a turn (15 minutes) and at two additional PL you heal immediately.

A sickly gray cloud envelops the area around the target, reaching a S distance in all directions. Anyone ending their turn in the cloud takes 1 STR damage. The cloud obscures vision, see zone feature: dark/foggy (Player’s Handbook Page 88). It lasts 1 round per PL, but is dispersed after only one round if there are strong winds. It does not follow the target if it moves away.
You can stanch a bleeding wound by manipulating the iron levels in the blood, automatically saving the life of a person who has sustained a fatal critical injury.

system.ingredient: See Epic Magic (Epic Magic ingredients do not increase Power Level)
system.description:
Special: Epic Magic.

This is an Epic Spell, see the description for those in this booklet. Each PL requires an ingredient. This ritual permanently raises the land in your current hex of land and must be performed in its epicenter. You and any objects and people in the hex will be targeted as if by the @UUID[Compendium.world.spells.Item.sPEfxTeVIZCCnlAe]{Earthquake} spell of an equal PL. If made at sea, nearby coastal areas will instead be affected by a @UUID[Compendium.world.spells.Item.eFSSYoalkvl9JdXe]{Flood Wave}, see page 24 in the Bitter Reach.

Raise sea floor: You can turn a sea floor into a marshland or quagmire. Cost 1 if next to a shore, or 2 if out at sea.

Raise land: You can turn a marshland or quagmire into plains, plains into hills, hills into mountains or mountains into high mountains. Cost: 1 per level.

Lower land: You can also lower land, although no known use of this has ever been recorded. Cost 1 per reduction of size: high mountains into mountains, mountains into hills, hills into plains, plains into marshland or quagmire, and marshland or quagmire into a shallow lake, a shallow lake into a deeper lake.

Unstable: The spell is unstable and some levels of the effect will be neutralized after 1: [[/r 1d6]] QD, 2: [[/r 2d6]] days, 3: [[/r 2d6]] weeks, 4: [[/r 2d6]] months, 5: [[/r 2d6]] years, 6: Never, it is actually stable. The GM makes this roll in secret. Cost: 1 corruption per unmade level of effect.
Emulating the shell of a tree, you cover your skin with a layer of bark. You receive a natural Armor Rating equal to the PL, but suffer a -2 penalty to manipulation until the spell’s effects end.

You can create horrid contagions with which to torment your enemies. Your victim, who must be a living humanoid, contracts a disease with a Virulence equal to the PL multiplied by 3. Feel free to describe the nature of the contagion in detail.

You prepare a specific spell you know, so that the next time you use it, you will cast it as power word. You cannot prepare rituals in advance. When cast, you can have a maximum of PL amount of prepared spell, any more than that will become lost. The same spell cannot be prepared multiple times.

system.duration: One round per Power Level and two liters of water
system.description: carried in one’s arms You can make steam shoot out of a carried water container with such force that you are lifted off the ground, either rising vertically one meter per round or flying horizontally one zone per round until the effect wears off or the water runs out. If aimed at a living creature within A range, the steam inflicts one point of damage to STR per round.

By holding pieces of a wooden object together, you can mend it restoring 1 item die or attribute damage per PL. If an item is not fully made out of wood, it can only restore a single missing point. This spell can then not restore such an object again until it is damaged anew.

You can send a message to a person within the same forest by whispering it to a tree. The recipient will hear the message from a tree close to them and can for the duration send messages back. Each PL can add a recipient.

You can let your inner eye wander across vast distances, over oceans and land, mountains, and valleys, and see what is happening there right now. FARSIGHT does not help you find a place – you must know where it is located to be able to see it. PL 1 lets you view a place at L range. PL 2 reaches across the same map hex where you are. Further away requires PL 3. Viewing a location that you haven’t been to before increases the required PL by 2. Your visions are often fragmented and cryptic – the GM decides exactly what you can see.

This spell works just like @UUID[Compendium.world.spells.Item.xx5EC5vj4ncazA0I]{Illusion}, except that you only get to roll for insight if someone interacts with the illusion. On a failure it still tries to fool all your senses. Some interactions will be too hard to emulate correctly, for instance: You could during the first second think that you are standing on an illusionary bridge, but would maybe start to question what happened when you suddenly lay bleeding on the ground below, without remembering falling. An illusionary dragon’s breath could make you think and feel like if you were on fire, but you would in reality find yourself unharmed when the effect ends.

system.duration: One turn (15 minutes) per Power Level
